            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }

	show_disabled = yes

	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }

	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_1_cost

	province_modifier = {
		epidemic_resistance = local_hospital_epidemic_resistance_tier_1
	}



	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_medicaments
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				province_size_baseline_add = local_hospital_province_size_per_medicaments_need
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {

	}

	next_building = local_hospital_2
	type_icon = "resource_buildings/local_hospital.dds"

	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_consumer_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_medicaments }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_resource_new_building_modifier = yes
	}
}
